mapper.select: SELECT MA.MAC_ADDRESS FROM USER_MAC_ASSOCIATION MA, NYEHMS_USERS_VW NU WHERE UPPER(NU.LEGACY_UID) = UPPER(#{userId}) AND NU.END_DATE IS NULL AND SYSDATE >= MA.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND (MA.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE IS NULL OR MA.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE > SYSDATE) AND MA.USER_ID = NU.WORKER_ID
SELECT IS_LOCKED FROM NYEHMS_USERS_VW WHERE UPPER(LEGACY_UID) = UPPER(#{userId}) AND END_DATE IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(ROLE_CODE) AS ROLE_COUNT FROM USER_REGION UR, NYEHMS_USERS_VW NU WHERE UPPER(NU.LEGACY_UID) = UPPER(#{userId}) AND NU.END_DATE IS NULL AND (UR.END_DATE IS NULL OR UR.END_DATE > SYSDATE) AND NU.WORKER_ID = UR.WORKER_ID
SELECT JRE_VERSION, REJECT_FLAG FROM NYEHMS_JRE_VERSIONS WHERE SYSDATE >= EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND (EFFECTIVE_END_DATE IS NULL OR EFFECTIVE_END_DATE > SYSDATE)
SELECT VERSION, REJECT_FLAG FROM NYEHMS_FIREFOX_VERSIONS WHERE SYSDATE >= EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND (EFFECTIVE_END_DATE IS NULL OR EFFECTIVE_END_DATE > SYSDATE)
SELECT VERSION FROM NYEHMS_FIREFOX_VERSIONS where EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = (select max(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE) from NYEHMS_FIREFOX_VERSIONS)
select JRE_VERSION from NYEHMS_JRE_VERSIONS where EFFECTIVE_START_DATE = (select max(EFFECTIVE_START_DATE) from NYEHMS_JRE_VERSIONS)
SELECT PARAM_VALUE FROM NYEHMS_PARAMETER WHERE PARAM_NAME = 'VALID_OS' AND SYSDATE >= EFFECTIVE_START_DATE AND (EFFECTIVE_END_DATE IS NULL OR EFFECTIVE_END_DATE > SYSDATE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_ACCESS_ATTEMPTS (ACCESS_ATTEMPTS_ID, USER_ID, HCS_ROLE, LINK_CLICK_TIME, ACTIVE_MAC_ADDRESS_LIST, HAS_NYEHMS_ACCESS, USER_LOCKED, ATTEMPT_MAC_ADDRESS, BROWSER_USED, BROWSER_VERSION, HAS_XPI_PLUGIN, XPI_VERSION, OS_USED, JRE_VERSION, RECORD_CREATED_DATE, REASONS_ATTEMPT_FAILED) VALUES (USER_ACCESS_ATTEMPTS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{hcsRole}, #{linkClickTime}, #{activeMACAddresses}, #{activeNyehmsRole}, #{userLocked}, #{attempMACAddress}, #{browserName}, #{browserVersion}, #{XPIPlugin}, #{XPIVersion}, #{OSName}, #{JREVersion}, #{recordInsertTime}, #{attemptFailedReasons})
mapper.select: SELECT REASON_CD, SHORT_DESC, DESCRIPTION FROM CODED_INIT_FAILURE_REASONS ORDER BY REASON_CD
